paras: Noah and his sister plan a [[picnic|picnic]] beside the [[river|river]]. They carry bread, fruit, and a bottle of [[water|water]].
A dark [[cloud|cloud]] appears while they eat [[lunch|lunch]]. The air becomes cool, but the river remains calm.
Noah gives his sister his [[coat|coat]]. They pack their food and reach home just before the rain begins.
zh: 诺亚和妹妹计划在河边野餐。他们带了面包、水果和一瓶水。
他们吃午餐时出现了一朵乌云。空气变凉了，但河水仍很平静。
诺亚把外套给了妹妹。他们收好食物，刚好在下雨前回到家。

q.s: They take water to the picnic.
q.why: They carry a bottle of water.
The passage says the river remains calm.
Their way home is not described.
